swatches.name: SAM Green
swatches.role: The brand colour. Primary actions, links, highlights and mascot backgrounds.

swatches.name: Live Green
swatches.role: Something is running or succeeded. Also the SAM wordmark on dark grounds.

swatches.name: Pressed Green
swatches.role: Hover and pressed states, and green text on light grounds.

swatches.name: Tile Green
swatches.role: Behind the mascot on the app icon, avatars and social profiles.

swatches.name: Hair Lime
swatches.role: The mascot's hair. Illustration and brand graphics, never buttons or text.

swatches.name: Hair Light
swatches.role: Highlights in the hair.

swatches.name: Hair Shadow
swatches.role: Outlines and shade in the hair.

swatches.name: Void
swatches.role: The deep centre every app screen floats over.

swatches.name: Night
swatches.role: Page background on the website.

swatches.name: Pane
swatches.role: Cards, panels and other surfaces.

swatches.name: Rim
swatches.role: Borders and dividers.

swatches.name: Mist
swatches.role: Secondary text on dark grounds.

swatches.name: Frost
swatches.role: Main text on dark grounds.

swatches.name: Paper
swatches.role: Surfaces in light mode.

swatches.name: Forest Ink
swatches.role: Main text in light mode.

swatches.name: Amber
swatches.role: Waiting on you: needs input, attention counts. Never decoration.

swatches.name: Cyan
swatches.role: The first teammate to join a project.

swatches.name: Violet
swatches.role: The second teammate.

swatches.name: Rose
swatches.role: The third teammate.

swatches.name: Slate
swatches.role: Automations: schedules, triggers and other non-people.
